mapper.select: SELECT T.username, T.nickname, T.mobile, T.email, T.createDate, T.enabled, T.jobno, T.OWNER, R.AUTHORITY, R.alias, R.tenantId, O.id As orgId, O.alias As orgAlias, OL.ON_LINE, OL.OFFLINE_TIME, TC.NICKNAME CREATOR, T.EXPIRED_TIME FROM LA_USERS T LEFT JOIN (SELECT T1.userid,T1.authority, T2.alias, T2.tenantId FROM LA_USER_ROLES T1 INNER JOIN LA_ROLES T2 ON t2.AUTHORITY = T1.authority AND T2.enabled = 1) R ON R.userid = T.username LEFT JOIN LA_USER_ORGANIZATION UO ON T.username = UO.userid LEFT JOIN LA_ORGANIZATION O ON O.id = UO.organizationid LEFT JOIN LA_ONLINE_LOG OL ON T.USERNAME = OL.USERNAME LEFT JOIN LA_USERS TC ON T.CREATOR = TC.USERNAME WHERE T.username IN #{user.username} ORDER BY T.CREATEDATE DESC, T.USERNAME

SELECT T.username, T.nickname, T.mobile, T.email, T.createDate, T.enabled, T.jobno, R.authority, R.alias, O.id As orgId, O.alias As orgAlias, T.EXPIRED_TIME FROM LA_USERS T LEFT JOIN LA_USER_ROLES U ON U.userid = T.username LEFT JOIN LA_ROLES R ON R.authority = U.authority LEFT JOIN LA_USER_ORGANIZATION UO ON T.username = UO.userid LEFT JOIN LA_ORGANIZATION O ON O.id = UO.organizationid
AND (T.username LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{key}),'%') OR T.nickname LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{key}),'%') OR T.mobile LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{key}),'%') OR T.email LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{key}),'%'))
ORDER BY T.USERNAME

SELECT T.username, T.nickname, T.mobile, T.email, T.createDate, T.enabled, T.tenantId, T.jobno, R.authority, R.alias, O.id As orgId, O.alias As orgAlias, T.EXPIRED_TIME FROM LA_USERS T LEFT JOIN LA_USER_ROLES UR ON UR.userid = T.username LEFT JOIN LA_ROLES R ON R.authority = UR.authority LEFT JOIN LA_USER_ORGANIZATION UO ON T.username = UO.userid LEFT JOIN LA_ORGANIZATION O ON O.id = UO.organizationid WHERE T.username = #{username}
SELECT T.username, T.password FROM LA_USERS T WHERE T.username = #{username}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LA_USERS (username, password, nickname, mobile, email, createdate, enabled, tenantId, owner, jobno, creator, EXPIRED_TIME) VALUES(#{username}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{mobile,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{email, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createDate, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, 1, #{tenantId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{owner, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{jobno, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{creator, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{expiredTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
INSERT INTO LA_USER_ROLES (userid, authority, tenantId) VALUES (#{username},#{authority}, #{tenantId, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM LA_USERS T WHERE T.USERNAME = #{username})
mapper.update: UPDATE LA_USERS SET password = #{password} where username = #{username}
UPDATE LA_USERS SET enabled = #{enabled} WHERE username = #{username}

SELECT T.username, T.nickname, T.mobile, T.email, T.createDate, T.enabled, T.jobno, R.authority, R.alias, O.id As orgId, O.alias As orgAlias FROM LA_USERS T LEFT JOIN LA_USER_ROLES U ON U.userid = T.username LEFT JOIN LA_ROLES R ON R.authority = U.authority LEFT JOIN LA_USER_ORGANIZATION UO ON T.username = UO.userid LEFT JOIN LA_ORGANIZATION O ON O.id = UO.organizationid WHERE UO.ORGANIZATIONID = #{orgId}

AND T1.ID IN ( SELECT DISTINCT T.RESOURCEID FROM LA_ROLE_RESOURCES T WHERE T.AUTHORITY IN #{item} )

ORDER BY T1.res_rank, T1.parentid, T1.orderno

SELECT T.username, T.nickname, T.password, T.enabled, R.authority, UO.organizationid AS orgid, T.tenantId FROM LA_USERS T LEFT JOIN LA_USER_ROLES UR ON UR.userid = T.username LEFT JOIN LA_ROLES R ON R.authority = UR.authority AND R.enabled = 1 LEFT JOIN LA_USER_ORGANIZATION UO ON UO.userid = T.username WHERE T.ENABLED = 1
